item.title: iQOO 15 Ultra to launch with shoulder triggers and haptic feedback
item.description: iQOO is set to unveil a more gaming-focused smartphone supported by an essential hardware.iQOO 15 UltraiQOO gets more serious about gamingThe iQOO 15 Ultra is scheduled to launch in China next month.
